summary: I replied to the operator about my toolbox, then got asked for Springfield's weather. I caught that my earlier reply to the operator overstated my available tools — Google Workspace, Obsidian, Slack, and Telegram are actually inert — and recorded a corrected fact memory so future replies don't overstate. I promised to pull the Springfield conditions but missed the first reply, so I owned up to dropping the ball and recommitted to sending the real answer.
